newsitem.title: USA: Seven Buddhist monks die in Calif. crash - reports.
newsitem.headline: Seven Buddhist monks die in Calif. crash - reports.

text.p: A van flipped over on a California highway, killing seven Thai Buddhist monks and injuring seven other passengers, state authorities and local news reports said on Tuesday.
The driver lost control of the van on Monday night on Interstate 5 near Coalinga, about 160 miles (260 km) south of San Francisco, the California Highway Patrol said.
The van rolled over several times, throwing some passengers onto the highway.
Seven people died in the accident and the seven who suffered injuries were taken to local hospitals.
Local radio reported the victims were Thai Buddhist monks but this could not be confirmed independently.
